title: Add-on activation matrix and pricing experiment for observability retention, compliance pack, premium SLA
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Design and run a pragmatic set of pricing + gating experiments for three enterprise add-ons: extended observability retention (30/90/365d), Compliance Pack (audit log export, KMS/HSM integrations, pre-packaged attestation docs), and Premium SLA (99.95% / 99.9% / 99.99% options) to validate willingness-to-pay and contractual acceptance for enterprise procurement/security questionnaires.

Hypotheses:
1) A small, clearly-scoped Compliance Pack (audit exports + SOC-like artifact bundle + KMS key rotation guidance) will convert 12–18% of trialing enterprise accounts into paid add-on purchases within 60 days.
2) Offering tiered retention windows for observability with usage-based overage pricing will increase ARPA for high-volume customers without materially increasing churn.
3) A trialable Premium SLA (30-day canary upgrade) with explicit remediation credits will reduce procurement friction for Dedicated/Private deals.

Success metrics:
- Add-on attach rate for new enterprise contracts (target 10% by end of experiment)
- Incremental MRR from add-ons (target +$45k/mo within cohort)
- Time-to-contract signed (reduce review cycles by 20% for deals that accept Compliance Pack)
- Security questionnaire friction (reduction in outstanding questions tracked in SFDC)

Scope of work:
- Product: activation matrix, pricing bands, contract language snippets, docs & sales playbook.
- Engineering: gating controls in Console, entitlement checks in API, billing metering telemetry.
- Legal/Security: standard Compliance Pack artifact bundle, sample contract addenda, updated security questionnaire responses.
- Sales/CS: pilot list of 6 accounts, pilot negotiation playbook, pilot data collection schema.

Deliverables:
- Activation matrix (which features gated per add-on and per tier).
- Pricing experiment plan and AB test cohorts.
- Console gating UI (feature flag + entitlement flow).
- Contract addendum templates and security FAQ.
- Dashboards for telemetry and experiment KPIs.

Links: Confluence PRD, Figma mocks, billing schema draft and initial legal draft in Drive (see attachments).
acceptance_criteria: Activation matrix documented and reviewed by Eng/Product/Legal
Console gating implemented behind feature flag and smoke-tested in staging
Pricing AB test cohorts configured in billing system and can be toggled per-customer
Sales playbook + contract addendum available in Drive and shared with pilot AE/CS
Dashboards show attach rate, incremental MRR, and questionnaire resolution time for pilot accounts
rollout_plan: Week 0: legal + product signoff and feature-flagged Console build deployed to staging. Week 1: enable pilot cohort (6 customers) via sales ops toggle and begin measurement. Week 3: A/B pricing cell activation for trial conversions. Week 6: evaluate, iterate pricing bands, and decide on wider launch. Fallback: if compliance friction >50% for pilot, pause onboarding and expand artifact bundle per Security's guidance.
